method: Each sample is a new Node process that loads the kernel, runs the workload's setup entries in a new REPL session (web/repl-session.mjs, as the CLI does) and its entry once cold, then the warm runs in the same session. A further process times the cold entry with no phase observed, for the observation's cost. An outcome's text is a preview past 160 characters, with the whole text's length and hash. A value form, which a REPL or print workload shows, is its whole text, never cut at a width; a full normal form, which its !! twin shows, is displayed to at most 1000 characters, so an outcome whose entry normalizes the whole term also digests that normal form, its bound variables and dimensions numbered by binding depth. Phases are observed by wrapping the methods named in `phases`; a phase's figures exclude the phases nested in it. Counters are the kernel's cumulative work and the arena's net growth, compared across the cold samples; times are medians over samples on this machine, and include the observation's wrappers. Failed entries count the work and time spent before they failed. The depth sample repeats the cold entry, measuring the syntax depth of the nodes each normalization, comparison and check allocated, its times discarded.

contracts.repl: REPL evaluate: the value form, computed as far as it is shown
contracts.replNormal: REPL evaluate !!e: one checked normalization, printed without a redundant self-comparison
contracts.print: print(evaluate(e)): the value form, computed as far as it is shown
contracts.printNormal: print(evaluate(!!e)): the full normal form, printed
contracts.expected: evaluate e expecting v: the full normal form, compared with v's
contracts.pattern: evaluate e expecting p, p with holes or marks: each part computed as far as p observes it
contracts.patternNormal: evaluate e expecting !!p: the full normal form, matched part by part
contracts.scratch: closure experiment: the demanded natural only; untrusted, certifies nothing

phases.elaborate: Translator.term: elaborating source terms, with the kernel queries elaboration asks
phases.check: checker.checkSyntax, inside verify: checking the elaborated term
phases.normalize: kernel.normalize, wherever it is asked: the kernel's normalization, whose result is syntax (no separate readback)
phases.decode: checker.syntax.decode of a normal form, inside checker.normalForm: kernel syntax into terms
phases.demand: checker.derivedHead, outside other phases: the weak heads a pattern's parts demand
phases.inventory: checker.evaluated's own work: the closedness, assumption and kernel-extension inventory
phases.compare: checker.equal, outside other phases: comparing types, normal forms and patterns' parts
phases.render: checker.displayText, outside other phases: printing a value or message
phases.other: the rest of the entry: parsing, module and session bookkeeping, transactions
phases.execute: scratch: forcing the definition to a pair
phases.readback: scratch: forcing the pair's first component to a number; laziness defers most computation here
